name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: `key_lost` is already defined as dropping the key while `door_open` is false, so the hard Absence(key_lost) captures 'do not drop the key while the door is closed' (and the 'until opened' scope is built into the event definition), and the hard Existence(at_goal) covers 'Reach the goal'.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
